dct_description_sm: The Kensington Market Project is an ethnographic study of Toronto's Kensington Market neighbourhood. It documents the social and cultural life of people living, working, and visiting Kensington Market. Data collected for this project includes field notes, interviews, photographs, ephemera, and archival materials. This is an ongoing longitudinal study started in January 2015.
